title: Repaired Wheel Positions and the Full-Replacement Period on Store Replacements
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, the covered repairs already made on a wheel position shorten or remove the full-replacement period when the holder authorizes a store replacement of that position's tire. A position's covered repairs are its repair entries plus its out-of-area repair reimbursement entries on the certificate.

**Authorization repair route.** When the wheel position's covered repairs have reached the plan's covered repairs per wheel position, the full-replacement period does not apply and the authorization coverage percentage is the tread proration alone; when the position has at least one covered repair but fewer than that limit, the full-replacement period is cut to the plan's full-replacement months divided by 2, rounded down to whole months, so the replacement is in it only while at least the plan term less that shortened period remain as whole months to the expiration date; a position with no covered repair keeps the full-replacement period of the plan's full-replacement months.

| Plan | Covered repairs per position (limit) | Full-replacement months, no repair | Shortened period, 1 repair up to the limit | At the limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month | 2 | 3 | 1 | no period |
| 24-Month | 3 | 6 | 3 | no period |
| 36-Month | 4 | 12 | 6 | no period |
| Plus 36 | 4 | 12 | 6 | no period |
| Life-of-Tread | 6 | 12 | 6 | no period |
| Commercial LT | 4 | 6 | 3 | no period |

The plans are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36-Month, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT Protection plans.

*Hypothetical case.* On a 36-Month certificate, a position with 2 covered repairs is in the period only while at least 30 whole months remain to expiration; with 4 covered repairs it has no full-replacement period and is prorated on tread.
